summary: paperclip holds only four documents for NDA022072 (SPRYCEL / dasatinib): the original 2006 approval letter, two later supplement approval letters (2008, 2010), and the 2006 label. None of the substantive FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader, Medical Review, Office Director memo, Risk review) are available. A precise -F grep across all four available documents for 'Advisory Committee', 'committee', 'voted', and 'ODAC' returned no advisory-committee content (the only 'committee' hit is an unrelated ONS Clinical Practice Committee citation in the label's references). Therefore no advisory committee meeting can be established from the available documents, and no linkages can be extracted; adcom_held is set to false with no verbatim passage because the review documents that would address the AdComm are not in paperclip.
